question: Do the DLSU thesis record or GBIF/Plazi registration add an independent specimen-level Pasig fish dataset beyond Chavez et al. (2006)?

dlsuRepository.accessMethod: Directly reviewed the public institutional-repository metadata page, including title, author, May 2005 date, abstract, physical description, listed embargo end, and download link. The full-text download endpoint returned HTTP 403; no access control was bypassed.
dlsuRepository.metadataScope: The public page identifies a master's thesis with 66 leaves and gives an abstract. No thesis PDF, appendix, specimen table, or collection sheet was retrieved.

gbifPlazi.accessMethod: Reviewed indexed GBIF dataset metadata and search-result text, which label the registration Checklist and list Plazi as the host. Direct dataset-page and API opens were not retrievable; no endpoint download or occurrence-count query completed.
gbifPlazi.apiStatus: API endpoints were inaccessible in the available browser call; a local read-only request did not complete and was stopped.

thesisRecord.author: Joel M. Chavez
thesisRecord.abstractScope: A taxonomic and biogeographic study of specimens from five Laguna de Bay-basin sites, including Pasig River; the abstract reports Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus as the only one of the two study species collected there.
thesisRecord.relationshipTo2006Paper: Strong related-lineage candidate: same lead author, same five-site study scope, and matching species/site findings. The full thesis was unavailable, so the degree of text, specimen, or data reuse was not checked.

gbifRegistration.descriptionScope: Indexed description reproduces the 2006 paper's taxonomic treatment and abstract-level five-site result.
gbifRegistration.relationshipTo2006Paper: A GBIF-registered checklist/taxonomic-treatment representation of the same publication, not an independent specimen collection or occurrence-event dataset.
gbifRegistration.countInterpretation: No GBIF occurrence API result count was obtained; do not infer zero records or any particular occurrence total.

primaryArticle.alreadyReviewedPasigFinding: The 2006 publisher paper reports Pterygoplichthys disjunctivus at Pasig River, City of Manila, and says P. pardalis was not collected at that site in the study; exact collection date, site-specific voucher number/count, and coordinates are not provided.

evidenceDecision.decision: Treat the thesis metadata and GBIF checklist as related provenance records for the previously reviewed 2006 study. They provide no independently reviewed Pasig specimens, dates, vouchers, coordinates, or occurrence rows.

nonClaims: The end of the listed thesis embargo does not prove that the current download endpoint is accessible or grant permission to redistribute the thesis.
The thesis abstract is not a substitute for its full methods, tables, specimen catalog, or appendices.
A GBIF CHECKLIST dataset is not treated as an occurrence-event record set here; its occurrence API count was not verified.
A failed page/API request is not evidence that records do not exist.
No modern Pasig fish presence/absence, fishing access, catchability, legal status, safety, geometry, or habitat claim is established.
nextActions: Continue with separately published, source-resolved Pasig or connected-water fish studies; keep same-study thesis/article/checklist records deduplicated as one research lineage.
If an authorized full-text path becomes available, inspect the thesis's collection dates and voucher appendix before revising the site evidence; do not bypass the current HTTP 403.
Continue freshwater, brackish, marine, and wetland evidence review across NCR; keep the NCR baseline and Luzon phase incomplete.
